image_description: A vintage orange and cream minibus (resembling a Volkswagen LT or similar model) driving on a paved road in a residential area with brick houses in the background. The vehicle features a boxy shape, a destination sign on the roof, and visible side windows.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Boxy body shape noticeably shorter than a full-size bus, yet tall enough for passengers to stand or sit upright comfortably.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The vehicle clearly exhibits a high-roof, boxy van/minibus silhouette that is significantly shorter than a standard city bus but tall enough for passenger capacity.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Large windshield and row of side windows along passenger area.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: A large front windshield is visible, and there is a distinct row of rectangular side windows running along the passenger compartment.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Height is substantial, with entrance door at front or mid-body.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The vehicle has substantial height relative to its width. A door seam is visible behind the front wheel arch, indicating a front/mid-body entrance typical of this class.
Vertical seams and handle structures consistent with a sliding or folding door mechanism are visible on the side.
There is a distinct hood/bonnet section ahead of the windshield containing headlights and a grille, indicating a front-engine layout.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Rear flat or slightly angled panel with taillights and license plate mount.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The rear of the vehicle is occluded by the viewing angle; only the front three-quarters are visible.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: White, yellow, or company livery paint with route markings.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The vehicle features a two-tone orange and cream livery with a destination blind on the roof, fitting the description of company/route markings.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Standard van-sized wheels with steel or alloy rims.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The visible front wheel is proportional to a light commercial vehicle/minibus, appearing to be a standard steel rim.
The window configuration (driver + ~3-4 side windows) suggests a seating capacity within the 4-10 passenger range.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The characters on the front license plate are distorted and illegible, resembling AI-generated pseudo-text rather than clear alphanumeric characters.
The brickwork on the background houses and the metal fence exhibit slight smearing and lack of fine geometric detail, typical of generative models struggling with complex repetitive patterns.
The side mirror assembly and door handles lack crisp mechanical definition, appearing slightly melted into the bodywork.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the specific vehicle classification matches the 'minibus' label and distinguish it from standard vans or full-size buses.
To verify the spatial relationship between the vehicle and the background houses, ensuring no floating elements or depth bleeding.
To check for clean boundaries around the wheels and body panels, detecting any fusion artifacts common in vehicle generation.
To rigorously analyze the legibility and structure of the text on the license plate and roof sign, which showed signs of gibberish.

focus_areas: Text legibility on license plate and destination blind
Wheel geometry and connection to chassis
Side mirror and door handle structural integrity
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the license plate text; AI often fails here. Also, verify if the background buildings have coherent perspective lines or if they warp near the vehicle edges.
